frontend_api.evidence: Reviewed existing public entry points; only opt-in IVPPMLConfig additions. New snapshot/approvals retain immutable 0.10.0 history.
frontend_api.description: Public call signatures, exports, aliases, CLI/front-end validation and compatibility.

backend_compute.evidence: econhdfe/iv/step.py and models/ppml_iv/outer.py; FE kernels, ordinary PPML and linear IV are unchanged. See theory note.
backend_compute.description: Solver/compute/cache/backend contracts, numerical defaults and resource controls.

errors.evidence: Reviewed forcing, line-search, exhausted-iteration and unsupported-BlockDesign explicit errors; no silent fallback to a different target.
errors.description: Structured exception classes, codes, stages, suggestions and public error boundaries.

public_contract.description: Public exports/signatures, result/config schemas and stable structured-error compatibility.

skill.evidence: skills/econhdfe/references/configuration.md and SKILL.md explain modern/legacy target, diagnostics and unsupported scope.
skill.description: Agent skill commands, examples, decision rules and newly exposed controls.

linked_modules.evidence: IRLS dispatch, estimator final inference state, stable IV fallback and heterogeneous routing reviewed together.
linked_modules.description: Cross-module imports, shared schemas, adapters, compatibility shims and downstream consumers.

results_reporting.evidence: New diagnostics[outer]; modern epsilon is equation residual. Returned beta/eta/mu/inference are at the same accepted point.
results_reporting.description: Result fields, publication output, diagnostics metadata and serialization-facing schemas.

config_defaults.evidence: outer_solver=legacy remains default; new mode has FE-only separation. Sample policy is an independent choice.
config_defaults.description: Config objects, defaults, deprecations, aliases and backwards-compatible behavior.

cache_state.evidence: Persistent X/Z FWL residualization reused with changing weights; warm starts projected onto current specification. No shared caches mutated.
cache_state.description: Reusable state/cache invalidation, fingerprints, lifecycle semantics and stale-state hazards.

tests_validation.evidence: Independent references and failure tests reviewed in tests/numerics/test_iv_outer_moment.py; execution outcomes tracked separately in validation/iv_outer.
tests_validation.description: Regression tests, install smoke tests, golden/parity coverage and failure-path tests.

performance.evidence: Repeated 1M/5M full-estimator protocol and stage attribution reviewed; see validation/iv_outer/formal and environment.json. No universal multiplier.
performance.description: Representative benchmark/resource regressions for code paths materially changed by the release.

docs_migration.evidence: README, Chinese README, CHANGELOG, theory note and validation/iv_outer/README.md describe the opt-in candidate and boundaries.

packaging_dependencies.evidence: No new runtime dependency or native extension; standard wheel/sdist build reviewed. Execution evidence tracked separately.
packaging_dependencies.description: Python/dependency matrix, optional extras, wheel/source contents and build metadata.

external_validation.evidence: Explicitly reviewed as deferred: no new licensed Stata, cross-platform, dependency-floor or Rust certification; not a formal release.
external_validation.description: Licensed/reference-environment parity gates and explicitly deferred external certification.

release_artifacts.evidence: Development candidate only; builds/hashes recorded separately. No publishing or tag; reviewed does not imply execution passed.
release_artifacts.description: Version consistency, source/wheel parity, hashes, clean install and reproducible bundle contents.
